title: Fourier degree bounded by decision tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a decision tree indexed by $A$ with real-valued leaves. The vector Fourier degree of the function computed by $T$ is at most the depth of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$T$ is a decision tree indexed by $A$ with real-valued leaves
